subject.title: fix(agents): drop stale internal orphan prompts

question: Should maintainers keep this stale-internal-drop strategy as a landing candidate, or choose the proof-positive preserve-as-context strategy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 as canonical?
rationale: Both open PRs target the same session-state bug but change the prompt/session repair semantics differently, and this PR still lacks real behavior proof for its drop/preserve split.

options.title: Require proof before choosing this PR
options.body: Keep this PR open but blocked until redacted embedded-agent runtime proof shows internal handoff text is dropped and `sessions_send` remains preserved.

options.title: Make the sibling PR canonical
options.body: If maintainers prefer preserve-as-context semantics, treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 as the landing path and close this PR after that direction is explicit.

options.title: Accept maintainer-held evidence
options.body: Maintainers may proceed with this PR only if they already have equivalent private runtime proof and accept the six-source drop predicate.

recommendation.title: Require proof before choosing this PR
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open but blocked until redacted embedded-agent runtime proof shows internal handoff text is dropped and `sessions_send` remains preserved.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the queued orphan prompt preservation behavior and are the strongest history signal for the repair invariant.
